content.short: Funfair is a blockchain company focused on transparency in online gambling, offering Ethereum-based interactive casino games.
content.description: Established in 2017, FunFair is a blockchain-focused firm aiming to revolutionize the online gambling industry. The platform uses the FUN token for winnings and bets and is built on Ethereum, with a focus on transparency and accountability to deter cheating by operators or players. It centers on interactive casino games like virtual slots, designed for Gen Z and Y players, with transparency and accountability at its core.
